ops.oldText: either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other
ops.newText: Contractor may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon 90 days' advance written notice to Company

ops.text: (c) Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon 30 days' written notice to Contractor, in which case Contractor shall refund prepaid fees on a pro-rata basis for the period after the effective date of termination. "Customer" means Company.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need a convenience exit that works while a Statement of Work is running, so we have added a Customer (Company) right to terminate on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and confined Contractor's at-will right to periods with no outstanding Statement of Work on 90 days' notice.
proposal.summary: Add a 30-day Customer convenience right with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and limit Contractor's at-will exit to 90 days' notice between Statements of Work.

mappings.element: No more than 30 days' written notice.
No Vendor termination-for-convenience right during a committed term.
